$Comment: What a player sees and hears the instant a cosmetic flair is unlocked for them, whether a
quest or an achievement paid it as a Flair reward or an administrator ran /zigflair grant. It
fires only for a flair the player did not already have; granting one again is silent.
This is the library's own neutral default, so a bare server gets a notice out of the box. A
mod that ships a file with this same name in its own pack replaces it (a pack that lists this
library as a dependency loads after it), and a server owner can do the same from the owner
layer. Override the whole file rather than editing this one.
The moment carries 'flair' (its id) and 'name' (what the flair is called, already in the
reader's language: the flair.<id>.name entry from whichever lang file ships it, else the id
spelled out as words). 'player' is always the name of who unlocked it.
Key is a line from a .lang file; Args names which of those values fill its blanks, in order.
Sound is any SoundEvent id, played at the player's own position. Delete either group in your
override to drop that half; add a Broadcast group to tell the whole server. Tone colours the
whole notification - gold Reward here, because an unlock is a payout.
